title: Riva 92 Duchessa
highlights: Customs and VAT paid in the UAE
Midship master with private main-deck access
description:
This 2015 Riva 92 Duchessa features the slender, aggressive yet harmonious profile Riva is famous for, with a large integrated windshield and wide windows flooding the saloon and dining areas with light.

The midship master cabin offers privacy, a full-beam bathroom and its own independent access from the main deck. Twin MTU 2,218 HP engines with only 750 hours give 28 knots. Registered in the UAE with customs and VAT paid.
